title: How to check Customer Statement?
description:
Need a full breakdown of a customer's transactions? In this Swash tutorial, you'll learn how to view customer statements — perfect for reviews, reconciliations, and follow-ups.

✅ In This Video You’ll Learn:

How to access customer statements in Swash

Viewing all transactions, orders, and payments

Exporting statements for sharing or record-keeping

Using filters to narrow down data
